newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan's queen to visit Belgium air crash families.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's queen to visit Belgium air crash families.

text.p: Jordan's Queen Noor will go to Belgium on Thursday to pay condolences to the families of eight people killed when a Jordanian pilot crashed his plane at an air show, a palace official said on Wednesday.
"Her Majesty Queen Noor will be arriving in Belgium on Thursday to meet the injured and pay her respects to the families of the deceased," the official told Reuters.
The American-born wife of King Hussein was expected to visit the families on Friday and meet some of the dozens of injured, the official added.

A plane flown by Captain Amr Hani Bilal of Jordan's elite Royal Falcons team spun out of control at the air show in Ostend last weekend and crashed, raining debris and spraying burning fuel. The pilot was killed.
